title_fr: Cliniques et structures de soins d'Algérie
title_ar: عيادات ومرافق الرعاية الصحية في الجزائر
coverage_note: Clinics and proximity-care facilities from OpenStreetMap. A community-maintained extract, NOT an official registry: it mixes the public proximity tier (polycliniques, salles de soins, centres de santé) with private clinics and maternities, and coverage is partial and uneven by wilaya. It complements @geoalgeria/sante, which carries the Ministry of Health registry tier (CHU/EPH/EHS/EPSP) that is excluded here. Every OSM element @geoalgeria/sante itself references is excluded from this package by construction, so no place is published twice under the same OSM element; sante's remaining records carry no OSM reference, so the same physical establishment can still appear in both packages under different coordinates. The two describe different tiers and must never be summed.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap: clinics & proximity-care facilities in Algeria

linkage_note: wilaya_code is derived by point-in-polygon against the 69 wilaya boundaries; commune is the nearest centroid WITHIN that wilaya, so the join never crosses a wilaya boundary. Wilaya is effectively exact, commune is best-effort.
